mapper.select: SELECT INT_RATE intRate FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO WHERE INT_RATE_ID = #{string,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and EFF_DATE = ( select max(EFF_DATE) from MST_INT_RATE_INFO where INT_RATE_ID = #{string,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT A.INT_RATE intRate, B.WEIGHT weight FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO A, MST_INDEX_COMPONENT B WHERE B.INDEX_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.COMPONENT_ID = A.INT_RATE_ID AND to_char(A.EFF_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{SESSION_SYS_DATE}

SELECT DISTINCT MF.FEE_ID feeId, MF.FEE_NAME feeName, MF.BASIC_BILL basicBill, MF.BASIS basis, FFCR.AST_VDATE_TYPE astVdateType, FFCR.BASE_RULE baseRule, FFCRU.F_ACCR_DATE fAccrDate, FCI.CASH_ID cashId,
FFCRU.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FFCRU.ACCR_TYPE accrType, FFCRU.INTERVAL_RULE intervalRule, FFCRU.ACCR_TDAY_RULE accrTdayRule, FFCRU.F_ACCR_END_DATE fAccrEndDate, FCPR.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate, FCPR.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, FCPR.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP, MST_FEEINFO MF, FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE FFCR, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE FFCRU, FIN_CASH_INFO FCI,
FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR
FP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
AND FP.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND FCI.CASH_ID = FFCR.CASH_ID AND FCI.CASH_ID = FFCRU.CASH_ID
AND FCI.CASH_ID = FCPR.CASH_ID
AND FCPR.EFF_DATE = FFCRU.EFF_DATE AND FFCR.EFF_DATE = FFCRU.EFF_DATE and FFCR.Eff_Date =
(SELECT MIN(A.EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE A,FIN_CASH_INFO B,FIN_PRODUCT C WHERE C.FINPROD_ID =#{finprodId} AND C.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.CASH_ID = A.CASH_ID
) AND FCI.FEE_ID = MF.FEE_ID

SELECT VDATE vdate, MDATE mdate, OPERATION_TYPE operationType， CALENDAR_ID calendarId FROM FIN_PRODUCT
FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

select CASH_ID cashId, ACCR_DATE accrDate, ACCR_STR_DATE accrStrDate, ACCR_END_DATE accrEndDate, VAL_DATE valDate from FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE where CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ACCR_DATE <=#{effDate,jdbcType=DATE} order by ACCR_DATE
select COUNT(1) from FIN_OPEN_PLAN where FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_STR = TO_DATE(#{dateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD')-1

select foru.OPEN_MODE from FIN_CASH_INFO fci left join FIN_OPEN_RULE foru on foru.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID where fci.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fci.CASH_TYPE_1 = '01' and fci.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C01'

select fcr.IS_INITIAL from FIN_CASH_INFO fci left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fcr on fcr.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID and fcr.EFF_DATE = TO_DATE(#{effDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') where fci.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fci.CASH_TYPE_1 = '03' and fci.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C04'
